description: Updates the project's Incidents tool configuration. Modifies privacy defaults and/or the default distribution list for new incidents. Distribution list members must have at least Read-level permissions to the Incidents tool.

private_by_default.description: Ensures that all Incidents are private by default

default_distribution.description: Users in the default distribution list

private_by_default.description: When true, new incidents are created as private by default. When false, new incidents are public and visible to all users with Incidents tool access.

default_distribution_ids.description: Array of Login Information IDs for users to include in the default distribution list for new incidents. Only users with Read or higher permissions to the Incidents tool are included in the response.
